notes:
Account summary: Aegis Lexicon provides secure archive search to multiple defense customers. Heavy focus on on-prem/air-gapped deployments and strict procurement. They want Redwood for embeddings + reranking to replace legacy keyword stack.

Key asks / constraints:
- Must be deployable air-gapped; offline model packaging + signed installer + documented install runbook.
- HSM/KMS integration (FIPS-validated HSM preferred).
- Full audit logs and retention controls; 7+ years of searchable metadata required.
- Data residency: all corp + index data stays within government datacenter (no egress).
- Procurement: PO + DoD contractual terms; procurement lead has 10–14 week decision cycle.

Performance targets (from SE workshop):
- Corpus: ~200M documents (mixed short form & PDFs) ≈ 7–9 TB of indexable text.
- Query load: baseline 150 QPS, peaks 600 QPS during surge windows.
- Latency target: p95 end-to-end <200ms for semantic recall-only; reranker path p95 <350–400ms.
- Reranking flow: 100 candidate dense-retrieval pool -> cross-encoder rerank on GPU.
- Cost sensitivity: target <$0.002/query avg (includes dense retrieval + reranking).

POC milestones agreed:
- Week 1: security questionnaire & baseline infra design (on-prem architecture).
- Week 3: small ingest test (10M docs) and embedding pipeline (offline).
- Week 6: scale index test (50–100M docs) w/ latency profiling and batching configs.
- Week 8: reranker perf test on customer GPU hardware + profiling for quantization.
- Week 10: security review handoff to PMO + SOW finalize.

Sales notes / call quotes:
- CISO: "If we can't run completely air-gapped with signed installers and HSM support, we can't proceed."
- Head of Search Eng: "We need deterministic latency at scale — show us consistent p95 under surge with caching."
- Procurement: "SLA and incident response hours are negotiable, need standard DoD T&Cs added."

Internal recommendations: use Dedicated (reserved capacity) + Private on-prem bundle; prepare custom air-gapped packaging and offline model verification steps. Emphasize Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/caching and quantization to hit cost targets. Ensure SE/R&D support during reranker quantization tests.

Risks: procurement timeline may push deal to FY27; customer expects on-site validation and penetration test report prior to sign.

Short-term next steps: Ravi to deliver preliminary architecture diagram and SOW draft by 2026-03-12; Maya to coordinate PMO kickoff; Elena to prep onboarding/training plan for CSM signoff.
